description: Books a 30-minute introductory meeting with Ariel Adler on Google Meet for the user. Confirm the slot, name, email, phone and topic with the user first. On success both sides get an email with the Meet link and a calendar invite, and the user gets a reminder 30 minutes before. Use a "start" value returned by get_meeting_slots. Phone: an Israeli number (05X-XXXXXXX or +972…).

email.description: Their email (the confirmation and Meet link go here)

name.description: Full name of the person meeting Ariel

start.description: Slot start exactly as returned by get_meeting_slots (ISO 8601, UTC)

topic.description: What they want to talk about (business, need), ideally in Hebrew

name: book_intro_meeting
title: Book an introductory meeting
